Trump’s Golf Course Plans Hit a Legal Obstacle: His Own Social Media Posts

President Donald Trump faced a legal setback on Saturday when a federal judge temporarily blocked the planned closure of a public golf course and surrounding parkland in Washington, D.C. Among the evidence undermining his Administration’s justification: his own Truth Social posts.
